basics.name: Morgan Brown
basics.label: Senior Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Formally trained software engineer and US expat with over a decade of remote experience specializing in modern frontend frameworks, user interface architecture, and high-performance web ecosystems. My international journey began during a formative junior year of high school in Zaragoza, Spain, and eventually led me to Berlin, where I spent a defining decade building my career and achieving German naturalization. I am now entering an exciting new chapter, bringing my global perspective and technical expertise to Athens, Greece.Professionally, my career ranges from serving as the second employee scaling core browser extension tools and complex multimedia rendering features at Minerva, to engineering high- fidelity public goods funding applications. I excel at bridging the gap between rigorous technical implementation and clean design semantics, frequently partnering with premier creative agencies to deliver award-winning web platforms, including a Swiss Design Award winner. Combining a Master's in Software Engineering from Carnegie Mellon University with deep frontend mastery, I thrive on solving complex, highly interactive product challenges.

work.name: Drips
work.summary: Primary engineer for this Ethereum-native funding platform, focusing on full-stack feature delivery to enable on-chain financial support of open-source software and its dependencies. This role required engagement with the web3 stack, including smart contract interaction, protocol SDK contribution, and establishing robust, modern development and deployment practices.
highlights: Engineered and deployed critical, full-stack features using TypeScript, SvelteKit, and GraphQL in service of the financial viability of open-source projects.
Facilitated secure smart contract interaction via ethers.js and contributed to the core platform SDK for protocol management.
Established a production-ready deployment pipeline via Dockerization and managed reliable end-to-end testing with Playwright.
Represented the company at major industry events (Devcon, Berlin Blockchain Week, Funding the Commons), demonstrating the product to developers and potential clients.
Accelerated development workflows and enhanced code quality by integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Co-Pilot, IDE integrations like Cline) for rapid scaffolding.

work.name: Minerva
work.summary: Instrumental in building Minerva's core products designed to streamline process capture, documentation, and replay. Responsibilities spanned the entire product lifecycle, from deep integration within the Chrome Extension ecosystem to creating complex in-browser multimedia tools and integrating AI capabilities for content enhancement and translation.
highlights: Joined as the 2nd employee, successfully launching the initial product line, providing novel live-guidance and process-capture and replay capabilities.
Designed and executed a technical interviewing and evaluation process for new engineering hires.
Developed and maintained large-scale Chrome Extensions using JavaScript, Vue, and Go, and automated deployment to both the Chrome Web Store and Microsoft Add-ons.
Engineered complex in-browser video editing tools utilizing fabricjs and an FFMPEG web worker pool for immediate pseudo-video playback and rendering.
Integrated third-party AI APIs for advanced features, including user voice cloning, translation, and content enhancement.

work.name: kpiReady
work.summary: Architected and scaled a sophisticated metrics visualization and automated reporting platform for enterprise business clients.
highlights: Engineered a high-performance, platform-agnostic web capture API using Google Puppeteer to programmatically generate dynamic data visualizations and capture full-page snapshots from any web asset.

Managed and optimized custom AWS infrastructure clusters, implementing strict multi-tenant data isolation layers to securely ring-fence customer data while enabling internal engineering teams to build, test, and merge product features asynchronously.

work.name: Lexicon Labs
work.summary: Spearheaded the technical development of natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning solutions aimed at optimizing professional email composition workflows.
highlights: Orchestrated a major product pivot and system architecture redesign, transitioning the core technology stack to power a robust, scalable digital platform connecting users with professional life coaches.

work.name: onlinebusiness.lol
work.summary: Directed technical strategy, engineering roadmap execution, and infrastructure decisions for a creative technology agency operating at the intersection of enterprise business logic and high-end visual design.

work.name: Sygns
work.summary: Provided strategic full-stack consulting and engineering execution for the development of a novel smart lamp hardware and software ecosystem.
highlights: Directed the requirements gathering, identification, and technical implementation of product configuration tools.
Partnered closely with Berlin-based graphic designers to engineer and launch high-fidelity web assets promoting the new product line to international markets.

work.name: Self Employed
work.summary: As a long-term freelance Software Engineer, I partner with designers and entrepreneurs to develop bespoke, full-stack solutions. This extensive period of self-employment has involved the end-to-end development, deployment, and maintenance of numerous complex client projects, utilizing a diverse technology stack including Vue.js, React, Django, Kirby CMS, Swift, and various front-end frameworks.
highlights: Led development for multiple award-winning projects in collaboration with Swiss design agencies, including the Dinamo Standards website (React/Contentful) and the Body of Us exhibit development.
Architected and fully deployed the Firstmate life coaching platform (Vue, Django, iOS web app wrapper) and Leo health promotion website (Vue/siteleaf) for two separate entrepreneurial ventures.
Developed and maintained several complex portfolio and documentation sites for artists and designers (Markus Mai, Joseph Kadow, Camille Aleña), frequently utilizing Vue.js and Kirby CMS.
Pioneered the development and rollout of Good Spread, a Shopify-based e-commerce website whose sales directly benefited children worldwide.
Conceptualized and developed the core platform for Futuress, a hybrid learning and publishing community focused on design politics, which won a Swiss Design Award in 2022.

work.name: SumAll
work.summary: Contributed to this marketing analytics startup by working on data integrations with other webservices via Java microservices.
highlights: Developed and maintained Java middle-tier services, managing the ingestion and storage of marketing data from 30+ external APIs (e.g., Klout, Recurly), providing analytics to 500,000+ businesses.
Implemented comprehensive unit and integration tests to allow confident, rapid iteration and code changes.
Built regular PDF-style reporting mechanisms for collected data using visualization libraries like D3 and Puppeteer.
Evolved existing Vue-based front-end to accommodate new data sources and ease future maintenance burden.

work.name: LinkedIn
work.summary: At LinkedIn, my focus was on enhancing the core profile experience and contributing to foundational, reusable front-end infrastructure that supported site-wide interactions. Contributions helped manage key social features and supported new initiatives targeting students and college populations.
highlights: Developed and shipped profile 2.0 experience and further enhancements used by millions of active users on the professional network.
Contributed to highly reusable front-end infrastructure for ubiquitous social features like like, comment, and share.
Helped to ignite and support new student and college initiatives.
Shaped company-wide front-end coding standards through internal group participation.
Presented boolean algebra basics to all web developers to level up their logical code quality.

work.name: Apple Inc.
work.summary: Developed core web applications using Ruby on Rails and JavaScript to coordinate and automate internal processes, spanning project planning, expenses, and event coordination. Work focused on establishing a robust development environment, co-creating an internal app 'ecosystem', culminating in the successful open-sourcing of a highly downloaded Ruby gem.
highlights: Transitioned from a co-located internship to a successful part-time remote engineer while completing undergraduate studies.
Developed internal automation tools (project, expense, and event planning) using Ruby on Rails and JavaScript, significantly improving operational efficiency for internal teams.
Established a new continuous integration environment and testing standards, co-creating an internal web-service-based application 'ecosystem'.
Authored and successfully open-sourced the CachedResource Ruby gem, which has accrued over 2.2 million downloads to date.

projects.name: Cached Resource
projects.description: Core contributor to a highly utilized open-source Ruby gem focused on maximizing performance and minimizing network overhead when interacting with web services via Active Resource. Designed and integrated much of the core structure and middleware logic to implement intelligent, query-parameter-based response caching.

projects.name: efemer.al (Serverless Web Architecture)
projects.description: Architected a 'vibe coding' experiment in serverless web architecture where the entire site content is stored within the URL hash. Developed custom logic to optimize, deflate, and Base85 encode Markdown content to bypass standard URL length limits, enabling 'unstoppable' content requiring no backend storage or central database.

projects.description: Engineered a sophisticated Chrome/Edge extension for capturing and editing procedural knowledge. Developed in-browser video editing tools and managed complex video processing via an in-browser web worker pool.

projects.description: Led the comprehensive frontend rebuild and responsive redesign of the Swiss Centre of Expertise in Human Rights (SCHR) digital platform prior to its organizational transition. Built a highly reactive, fluid frontend experience leveraging cutting-edge web typography via Variable Fonts to meet strict, pixel-perfect aesthetic demands.

Ensured full-stack stability and seamless API contracts across a distributed system architecture featuring a web client, a backend ecosystem, and a native mobile application.

projects.description: Engineered a bespoke portfolio for Berlin-based photographer Joseph Kadow. Implemented specialized mobile interactions and integrated Intersection Observer for advanced scroll-based behaviors, resulting in a feature in It's Nice That's 'Double Click' series[cite: 282, 283].

projects.description: Implemented a sleek, performant digital archive and portfolio site for artist Camille Aleña, translating complex visual layouts into a responsive web application. Focused on pixel-perfect frontend engineering, semantic markups, and cross-browser performance optimizations.

Programmed custom templates, integrated secure payment gateways, and optimized checkout funnels to handle high-traffic sales events efficiently.
